Definition: the south (as being on the right hand of a person facing the east)
BiblicalUsage: têymân is the Bible's word for the south. In Exodus 26:18, twenty boards on the south side southward, and it appears again in Isaiah 43:6.
TheologicalSignificance: Boards on the south side of the tabernacle tell me God gave directions for His dwelling down to which way it faces.
